The Applicant has filed this Application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for enlarging the Applicant on Regular Bail in connection with FIR being C.R. No.
11191031240196 of 2024 registered with Shahibaug Police Station, Ahmedabad for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(j), 376(2)(N), 270, 336, 344, 345, 346, 114, 328, 323 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3(a), 4, 5(L), 6, 8, 9(L), 10 and 5(J) (2) of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

sentences.text: only role attributed to the Application is to the effect that he had aided the other co-accused who happens to be his NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11364/2025 ORDER DATED: 06/08/2025 undefined brother, in abducting the prosecutrix.
Except this, there is no other overt act has been attributed to the present Applicant.

Learned Advocate for the Applicant has further submitted that the Applicant has good reputation in the society and no useful purpose would be served by keeping the applicant in jail for indefinite period.
It is further contended that the applicant is ready and willing to abide by all the conditions that may be imposed by this Court if released on bail.

5. Per contra, learned APP has opposed the present application for grant of regular bail contending that the present Applicant happens to be the brother of the other co-accused who was HIV Positive and the Applicant was also aware about the said fact.

Despite the same, the Applicant had helped the other co- accused in abducting the prosecutrix and thereafter she was kept in the house of the Applicant and the other co-accused for five months and during the which period, the other co-accused had forcibly established physical relations with the prosecutrix and, because of the same,
she also got pregnant.

Learned APP has therefore submitted that looking to the nature of offence,
this Court may not exercise the discretion in favour of the applicant and the Application may be dismissed.
6. Learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the Original Complainant has also opposed the Application and prayed to dismiss the Application.
7. Heard learned Advocates for the parties and perused the record.
It is the case on the part of the Applicant that he has been attributed the role of merely aiding the other co-accused in abduction of the prosecutrix.
However having regard to the material available on record, the role attributed to the present Applicant does not appear to be so simple.
It emerges from the record that the other co-accused had abducted the prosecutrix who happens to be brother of the present Applicant and he was HIV Positive.

The Applicant being the brother NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11364/2025 ORDER DATED: 06/08/2025 undefined ofthe said co-accused was very much aware of the fact that his brother was HIV Positive, despite the same, he had helped the other co-accused in abducting the prosecutrix and thereafter the prosecutrix was brought to their house, where she was confined for five months, and during the said period, the other co-accused had established physical relations with the prosecutrix without her consent and because of which she got pregnant.
8. Having regard to the aforesaid aspects, no case is made out.
The Application is dismissesd.
Notice is discharged.
(M. R. MENGDEY,J) J.N.W / 21 Gulam Husain @ Babu S/O Hamidkhan Pathan vs State Of Gujarat on 6 August, 2025
